clues.text: This town lies in south central Colombia, in a land famed for coffee. Old settler ways still shape its farms and daily life here.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside the coffee lands of central Colombia

source.quote: Palestina is a town in the south central region of the state of Caldas, Colombia.

clues.text: This one town has many kinds of weather in one small place. Low land by the Cauca River feels unlike the town seat high on the mountain.
clues.narrowing: narrows to a coffee town whose land climbs from a river bank to a mountain top

source.quote: This town has very different climatic zones, because its territory is from the banks of the Cauca River, to the county seat located at the top of the mountain.

clues.text: In twenty eleven, UNESCO put its old center and farm lands on its world list. The honor praised its coffee lands and old town ways.
clues.narrowing: narrows to coffee towns honored as a world heritage site in that year

source.quote: Because of this, the historic center of the town and surrounding rural areas were named part of the "Coffee Cultural Landscape" UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2011.

clues.text: Its airport name is Aeropuerto del Café, and it shouts its coffee roots. Farm exports fly from here to far markets.
clues.narrowing: near-decisive: points to the coffee town with an airport named for coffee

source.quote: Palestina's airport "Aeropuerto del Café", enables export cargo especially given the proximity to the city of Manizales (important industrial center)

clues.text: Think of a place whose heart and fields are guarded as a treasure for all mankind. Guides rank its streets among the globe’s most prized cultural landscapes.
